overview.title: The fallen titan
overview.caption: Full wreck on the unchanged road. White review sand marks Z = 0; buried geometry is intentionally occluded.

brow.title: Brow · face and propped head
brow.caption: Face, chin and forehead beneath the road, with the broken-neck supports below.

breach.title: Breach · north flank entrance
breach.caption: The northern wound, seen from outside along the approach into the chest.

ribcage.title: Ribcage · chamber overview
ribcage.caption: The northern chest opening, bronze ribs and frame surrounding the loop.

palm.title: Palm · fingertips to wrist
palm.caption: Approach over the open right hand. Inspect the road support across its full width.

arm-shoulder.title: Arm and shoulder
arm-shoulder.caption: Forearm seating and the approved pylon-supported climb above the upper arm.

collar.title: Collar and chin
collar.caption: Transition from the chest to the lifted head; collar plates and frame remain visible.

halo.title: Halo · full roll
halo.caption: Detached halo standing beyond the crown. The road rolls through the opening.

ribcage-high.title: Ribcage · inside the chamber
ribcage-high.caption: Wide view from inside the chest: the complete loop and the surrounding bronze frame.

hull-left.title: Hull · left bronze corridor
hull-left.caption: Inside the left route. Inspect the bronze walls and roof clearance over the road.

hull-gallery.title: Hull · right open gallery
hull-gallery.caption: Looking back from the exit along the raised right route, beside the ribs and the left corridor roof; its outside remains open.

exit.title: Exit · south flank
exit.caption: The opening where the two routes leave the southern flank.

sword.title: Sword · blade, guard and broken grip
sword.caption: The road around the buried blade. The snapped grip and pommel rest east of it.
